## Behavior and evidence

Describe the problem, final behavior, affected profiles and rollback.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Android/Python/native tests pass; exact commands/results included.
- [ ] Parser/serialization/disabled metadata and legacy compatibility reviewed.
- [ ] Pointer ownership, simultaneous input, stop/reload/disconnect reviewed when affected.
- [ ] Coordinate plane and insets unchanged; no invented HUD positions.
- [ ] Lint, advisory, license and secret reports reviewed; limitations stated.
- [ ] No package/signing/IPC/preferences identity change or unapproved deployment.
- [ ] Physical testing clearly marked verified or pending.
- [ ] Attribution and GPLv3 obligations preserved.
